keywords.rule: Counts are papers whose title or abstract contains one of the keyword's phrases (porter-stemmed, as the theme trends); the baseline is the papers in scope first submitted in the 12 weeks before the issue, its own papers excluded. new: fewer than 5 baseline papers; rising: at least 5 papers and a rate at least 1.5 times the baseline rate; hot: at least 15 papers (and 1% of the issue) at a rate at least 0.67 times the baseline rate; steady: otherwise.
keywords.score: log2(1 + n) · log2(1 + (n + 3) / (E + 3)), E = issue papers × (baseline papers with the phrase + 0.5) / baseline papers

themes.name: LLM agents: tools, coding, memory, enterprise
themes.summary: These papers build and evaluate LLM agents that call tools, write code, retain memory, and operate in enterprise, GUI, and help-desk settings. They include benchmarks for coding and spreadsheet tasks, harness-level studies of reliability and failure attribution, and memory or skill mechanisms that let agents reuse experience. The works differ in whether they contribute a benchmark, an orchestration or training method, or a diagnostic analysis of agent behavior.

themes.name: Embodied AI: robot learning and world models
themes.summary: These papers study robot policy learning from demonstrations and egocentric video, vision-language-action models, and world models used for simulation and navigation. They also cover sim-to-real transfer, humanoid and dexterous control, and real-to-sim generation of interactive environments. Contributions range from empirical analyses of model properties to new training recipes, datasets, and deployment studies.

themes.name: Scientific ML, neural operators, AI-for-science agents
themes.summary: These papers develop surrogate models and neural operators for physical simulation and build or benchmark agents that carry out scientific research tasks such as hypothesis construction and instrument control. Applications span molecular optimization, chemistry extraction, materials design, and geophysical or plasma modeling. Some works are methodological advances in physics-constrained learning, while others are agentic benchmarks and safety studies.

themes.name: Optimization methods and learning theory
themes.summary: These papers analyze optimizers, generalization, and online learning guarantees, often deriving sharp or optimal bounds. They cover gradient noise geometry, curriculum and continual effects, Gaussian process regression, and Bayesian optimization acquisition. Contributions range from theoretical characterizations to algorithmic variants and benchmark libraries.

themes.name: Efficient LLM inference, compression, long-context retrieval
themes.summary: These papers reduce inference and training cost through quantization, sparsity, speculative decoding, and efficient attention for long contexts. They also examine how long-context and multimodal models retrieve and use evidence. Some propose systems, kernels, and architectures, while others analyze tradeoffs such as when extra search or extra candidates actually pay off.

themes.name: Medical imaging and clinical decision support
themes.summary: These papers develop segmentation, classification, synthesis, and clustering methods for clinical imaging across histology, MRI, endoscopy, and cytometry. They address annotation efficiency, label noise, boundary errors, and explainability in diagnosis. Some focus on clinical deployment, triage, and decision support rather than imaging models alone.

themes.name: LLM evaluation, benchmarking, and rubric meta-science
themes.summary: These papers evaluate language models and their graders, asking whether accuracy, rubrics, and self-assessment measure what they claim. They benchmark domain tasks such as astronomy method selection and clinical policy, and audit datasets for label errors and duplicates. Some study claim-level information dynamics, calibration, and consistency in self- or multi-agent evaluation settings.

themes.name: Speech, audio, and multimodal social signals
themes.summary: These papers model speech, audio, and multimodal social signals for translation, emotion, and conversation understanding. They include streaming and full-duplex dialogue systems, speaker extraction, and music or singing analysis. The works differ in whether they target recognition, generation, or the behavior of interactive spoken systems.

themes.name: Privacy, poisoning, federated and continual learning
themes.summary: These papers study federated and continual learning under client heterogeneity, forgetting, and limited replay. They also address privacy attacks and defenses, including unlearning, watermarking, and poisoning in federated and code settings. Some contributions are algorithms or libraries, while others are benchmarks and analyses of attack or defense limits.

themes.name: RLHF, reward design, and LLM alignment
themes.summary: These papers align and post-train language and multimodal models using preference data, reinforcement learning, and reward shaping. They examine credit assignment, advantage reshaping, and the monitorability of reasoning. Some provide mathematical foundations, while others propose training recipes or reward-function design frameworks.

themes.name: Diffusion and flow-matching generative modeling
themes.summary: These papers develop diffusion and flow-matching methods for generation, editing, and representation learning. They address likelihood objectives on manifolds, guidance for compositional text-to-image alignment, and adaptation of distilled generators for downstream use. Some extend flow models to offline reinforcement learning and structured action trajectories.

themes.name: Sparse autoencoders, interpretability, and concept steering
themes.summary: These papers use sparse autoencoders and activation interventions to interpret and control model behavior. They study concept erasure, steering directions, and whether explanations are faithful rather than merely sufficient. Some provide theory for interpretability tools, while others apply them to diffusion models, vision encoders, and reasoning trajectories.

highlights.title: Full-Weight VLA Fine-Tuning Without an fp32 Master Copy Silently Erases Most Updates
highlights.theme: Embodied AI: robot learning and world models
highlights.why: Shows that bf16 fine-tuning without an fp32 master copy silently erases most updates in most open VLA codebases and can drop success rates dramatically, warning practitioners.
highlights.key_result: Without an fp32 master copy, bf16 training silently erases at least 79% of updates to bf16 weights in the paper's LIBERO runs; on LIBERO-Object, an fp32 copy raises success over LeRobot's storage from 4.3% to 49.3% for SmolVLA and from 5.1% to 80.9% for _0.5 at a ten-times lower learning rate, and from 89.0% to 97.7% for _0.5 at its default rate.
evidence: In our LIBERO runs without the copy, a probe every 100 steps finds at least 79% of updates to bf16 weights erased.

On LIBERO-Object, with rules fixed in advance, an fp32 copy raises success over LeRobot's storage from 4.3% to 49.3% for SmolVLA and from 5.1% to 80.9% for _0.5 at a ten-times lower learning rate, where both models are undertrained, and from 89.0% to 97.7% for _0.5 at its default rate.

highlights.title: TRACE: Data-Free Text Reconstruction Attacks against Approximate Unlearning in LLMs
highlights.authors: Mengying Zhang, Derui Wang, Ibrahim Khalil et al.
highlights.theme: Privacy, poisoning, federated and continual learning
highlights.why: Introduces TRACE, a data-free attack that reconstructs unlearned training data from pre- and post-unlearning snapshots, revealing a critical privacy side channel.
highlights.key_result: TRACE reconstructs unlearned training data from pre- and post-unlearning model snapshots without any data-specific prior knowledge, and extensive experiments across TOFU, MUSE, and WMDP, multiple LLMs, and six representative unlearning methods show high-fidelity reconstruction (e.g., ROUGE-L(R) above 0.93 on LLaMA2-7B, Mistral-7B, and LLaMA2-13B).
evidence: Here, we propose TRACE, a framework that reconstructs unlearned training data given access to pre- and post-unlearning model snapshots, without any data-specific prior knowledge.

Extensive experiments on various datasets, including TOFU, MUSE, and WMDP, across multiple LLMs and six representative unlearning methods, demonstrate that TRACE achieves high-fidelity reconstruction.

Furthermore, we observe that larger models are more susceptible to reconstruction than smaller ones due to their superior capacity for memorization. For instance, TRACE achieves ROUGE-L(R) above 0.93 on LLaMA2-7B, Mistral-7B, and LLaMA2-13B.

highlights.title: Data Quality in RVL-CDIP: A Systematic Audit
highlights.theme: LLM evaluation, benchmarking, and rubric meta-science
highlights.why: Systematically audits the de facto standard RVL-CDIP benchmark, revealing 10.5% label errors and 35.2% test duplicates, and releases a corrected corpus and re-benchmarked results.
highlights.key_result: The paper audits RVL-CDIP and finds that approximately 10.5%\ of its 400,000 documents have erroneous labels and that 35.2%\ of the test set has a duplicate or near-duplicate in the training set; it also shows that identification codes on the pages are sufficient to classify at 69% accuracy and that a state-of-the-art model loses 11 points without them.

highlights.title: Tool-Calling LLM Agents Under Realistic MCP Faults: Scale Does Not Purchase Fault Tolerance
highlights.authors: Antonio Ken Iannillo, Joshua Segun Owotogbe, Roberto Natella et al.
highlights.theme: LLM agents: tools, coding, memory, enterprise
highlights.why: Shows that larger tool-calling agents do not gain fault tolerance under realistic MCP faults, with task-completion falling 60% under fault injection.
highlights.key_result: Faults drawn from the permanent-heavy stress profile cause severe quality degradation, with task-completion score falling by 60% (from 8.08 to 3.23 out of 10), and scale does not purchase fault tolerance for the two gpt-oss backbones tested: the 120B retains no larger share of its fault-free score under faults (p = 0.96), and its completion rate under faults is, if anything, lower (91.1% vs. 95.6%; difference 4.4 points, 95% CI [-0.2, 9.3]).
evidence: In a 1,350-cell experiment crossing two backbone sizes (20B, 120B), three agent stacks (custom multi-round plan-and-execute, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangChain), and three fault injection conditions, we find that faults drawn from this permanent-heavy stress profile cause severe quality degradation (task-completion score falls by 60%, from 8.08 to 3.23 out of 10), and that scale does not purchase fault tolerance for the two gpt-oss backbones we test: the 120B retains no larger share of its fault-free score under faults (resilience-ratio model, p = 0.96), and its completion rate under faults is, if anything, lower (91.1% vs.\ 95.6%; difference 4.4 points, 95% CI [-0.2, 9.3]).

highlights.title: Compatible Likelihoods for Flow Matching on Manifolds
highlights.authors: Lucas Ng, Georgios Batzolis, Mark Girolami
highlights.why: Exhibits a failure mode of Riemannian flow matching on flat torus and proposes a compatible likelihood objective supported on feasible velocities.

news.title: Rapidly scaling online storage to serve over 1 billion ChatGPT users (Part II)
news.summary: Part II of OpenAI's series describes how it scaled Azure Cosmos DB as the storage layer behind Habitat, its online storage platform now serving over 500 petabytes of data to more than 1 billion users across 40 geographic regions. The post traces a multi-tenancy journey from one shared container to single-tenant containers and back to a multi-tenant default, settling on a co-managed container approach developed with the Azure team.

news.title: Securing our frontier model training environment
Bringing foundational models to the front lines of TB screening
news.summary: Google Research described work moving TB screening AI from a 2019 Radiology benchmark through external evaluation, WHO recommendation of CAD, and a September 2024 prospective multi-site validation in NEJM AI, toward open foundation models such as MedGemma. Partner Nexus AI obtained CE MDR class IIb certification for a clinical diagnostic tool built on the chest X-ray algorithms, with results presented at IDWeek 2026 in Washington, D.C.; the post cites an estimated 1.23 million TB deaths per year.

news.title: Kazakhstan Expands Compute for Its AI Future
news.summary: At an event in Astana on Oct. 23, NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang met President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev and spoke with AI minister Zhaslan Madiyev, while NVIDIA announced an investment in Kazakhstan-founded startup Higgsfield AI. Firebird signed an investment agreement with the government and secured a U.S. export license for 45,000 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPUs, with a first phase under construction with Kazakhtelecom at Data Center Valley targeting commercial launch in the third quarter of 2027.

news.title: Scaling NVIDIA TensorRT Performance Optimization Beyond a Single Build Route with the Global Performance Tuner, Part 2
news.summary: Part 2 of NVIDIA's series on the TensorRT 11.1 Global Performance Tuner describes treating scheduling choices as explicit, searchable build routes over more than 200 compiler knobs exposed via C++ APIs, with trtexec building and measuring each candidate and filtering by accuracy. Across ten evaluated workloads, tuning improved end-to-end performance by 1.14x to 1.63x over the default build route.

news.title: Scaling NVIDIA TensorRT Performance Optimization Beyond a Single Build Route with the Global Performance Tuner, Part 1
news.summary: Part 1 frames TensorRT engine building as a scheduling-based compilation problem and introduces the Global Performance Tuner, released in TensorRT 11.1, which generates candidate build routes and selects the fastest one satisfying end-to-end accuracy constraints. It states three guiding principles: accuracy-aware tuning, customizable build routes, and a large solution space.

news.title: Using AI Agents to Teach Robots Like Microduck to Walk in Simulation
news.summary: The post walks through a workflow for training a simulated Microduck robot, using Hermes and NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Bolt on NVIDIA RTX Spark to plan an obstacle course, Astra to build assets, Isaac Sim with Omniverse and Newton for simulation, and Isaac Lab to train a locomotion policy across 4,096 parallel environments on an RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition GPU. Policies are validated locally on RTX Spark before preparation for sim-to-real transfer using Better Actuator Models and domain randomization.

news.title: LitPivot: Developing research ideas through dynamic contextualization within the literature landscape
news.summary: LitPivot, built with University of Pennsylvania collaborators and using papers retrieved via Asta Paper Finder, segments a research proposal into problem, contribution, and evaluation facets, then groups and reranks literature per facet to produce excerpt-supported critiques and suggested revisions. In a study with 17 researchers, domain experts rated ideas developed with the system as better grounded in the literature than those made with a text editor and AI chat tool; an earlier analysis of four projects identified 21 literature-initiated pivots, and the work will be presented at UIST 2026 in Detroit.

news.title: Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning on Amazon SageMaker AI: A hands-on guide
news.summary: AWS described multi-turn reinforcement learning on SageMaker AI, where a training job calls an agent hosted on Bedrock AgentCore that plays Wordle for up to six guesses and returns a single reward, with GRPO updating a LoRA adapter on the policy model. In their run, gpt-oss-20b rose from 61 to 84 percent solve rate on held-out words at default reasoning effort and from 15 to 69 percent at the low effort it trained at, for about $339 in training tokens.

news.title: Orchestrating SageMaker AI endpoint auto scaling with AWS CDK
news.summary: The post explains that updating a SageMaker AI endpoint configuration fails when Application Auto Scaling resources are managed natively in CloudFormation, and offers a reusable CDK construct that replaces them with three custom resources to deregister and re-register scaling around the update. Register and attach steps use asynchronous completion handlers polled every 30 seconds under a provider timeout of 1 hour.

news.title: Visualize points and routes with GeoJSON in Amazon Quick Sight layer maps
news.summary: Amazon Quick Sight layer maps now accept Point and LineString geometries in GeoJSON, in addition to polygons, so users can plot individual locations and routes joined to a dataset by a shared key. The GeoJSON file must be in .geojson format with a maximum supported size of 100 MB, and each layer renders one geometry type at a time.

news.title: How Bayer Crop Science built an agentic decision engine on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore with AWS Unified Operations
news.summary: Bayer Crop Science built the Agentic Decision Engine, a multi-agent natural language interface over its Connected Decision Engine, on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore with LangGraph orchestration; in its first phase it resolves about 80 percent of user questions without an engineer in the loop. Bayer worked with AWS Unified Operations, including a Technical Account Manager and a generative AI Domain Specialist Engineer, in three technical standups per week from design through production.

highlights.title: Full-Weight VLA Fine-Tuning Without an fp32 Master Copy Silently Erases Most Updates
highlights.theme: Embodied AI: robot learning and world models
highlights.why: 表明在没有 fp32 主副本的情况下进行 bf16 微调会在大多数开源 VLA 代码库中静默擦除大部分更新，并可能大幅降低成功率，向实践者发出警告。
highlights.key_result: 在没有 fp32 主副本的情况下，bf16 训练会在本文的 LIBERO 运行中静默擦除对 bf16 权重至少 79% 的更新；在 LIBERO-Object 上，fp32 副本将 SmolVLA 的成功率从 LeRobot 存储的 4.3% 提升到 49.3%，将 _0.5 在低十倍学习率下从 5.1% 提升到 80.9%，并将 _0.5 在其默认学习率下从 89.0% 提升到 97.7%。
evidence: In our LIBERO runs without the copy, a probe every 100 steps finds at least 79% of updates to bf16 weights erased.

On LIBERO-Object, with rules fixed in advance, an fp32 copy raises success over LeRobot's storage from 4.3% to 49.3% for SmolVLA and from 5.1% to 80.9% for _0.5 at a ten-times lower learning rate, where both models are undertrained, and from 89.0% to 97.7% for _0.5 at its default rate.

highlights.title: TRACE: Data-Free Text Reconstruction Attacks against Approximate Unlearning in LLMs
highlights.authors: Mengying Zhang, Derui Wang, Ibrahim Khalil et al.
highlights.theme: Privacy, poisoning, federated and continual learning
highlights.why: 提出了 TRACE，一种无数据攻击，从反学习前后的快照中重建被反学习的训练数据，揭示了一个关键的隐私侧信道。
highlights.key_result: TRACE 在没有任何数据特定先验知识的情况下，从反学习前和反学习后的模型快照中重建被反学习的训练数据；在 TOFU、MUSE 和 WMDP、多个 LLM 以及六种代表性反学习方法上的大量实验表明，其重建保真度很高（例如，在 LLaMA2-7B、Mistral-7B 和 LLaMA2-13B 上 ROUGE-L(R) 高于 0.93）。
evidence: Here, we propose TRACE, a framework that reconstructs unlearned training data given access to pre- and post-unlearning model snapshots, without any data-specific prior knowledge.

Extensive experiments on various datasets, including TOFU, MUSE, and WMDP, across multiple LLMs and six representative unlearning methods, demonstrate that TRACE achieves high-fidelity reconstruction.

Furthermore, we observe that larger models are more susceptible to reconstruction than smaller ones due to their superior capacity for memorization. For instance, TRACE achieves ROUGE-L(R) above 0.93 on LLaMA2-7B, Mistral-7B, and LLaMA2-13B.

highlights.title: Data Quality in RVL-CDIP: A Systematic Audit
highlights.theme: LLM evaluation, benchmarking, and rubric meta-science
highlights.why: 系统性地审计了事实上的标准 RVL-CDIP 基准，揭示了 10.5% 的标签错误和 35.2% 的测试集重复，并发布了修正后的语料库和重新基准化的结果。
highlights.key_result: 本文对 RVL-CDIP 进行审计，发现其 400,000 份文档中约 10.5% 的标签错误，并且测试集中 35.2% 的样本在训练集中存在重复或近似重复；本文还表明，页面上的识别码足以达到 69% 的分类准确率，而没有这些识别码时，一个最先进的模型会损失 11 个点。
evidence: In this paper, we audit RVL-CDIP for data quality issues and find that approximately 10.5%\ of its 400,000 documents have erroneous labels and that 35.2%\ of the test set has a duplicate or near-duplicate in the training set.
Identification codes on the pages are sufficient to classify at 69% accuracy, and a state-of-the-art model loses 11 points without them.

highlights.title: Tool-Calling LLM Agents Under Realistic MCP Faults: Scale Does Not Purchase Fault Tolerance
highlights.authors: Antonio Ken Iannillo, Joshua Segun Owotogbe, Roberto Natella et al.
highlights.theme: LLM agents: tools, coding, memory, enterprise
highlights.why: 表明在现实的 MCP 故障下，更大的工具调用智能体并未获得容错性，任务完成率在故障注入下下降 60%。
highlights.key_result: 来自永久重负载压力分布的故障会导致严重的质量下降，任务完成分数下降 60%（从 10 分制的 8.08 降至 3.23）；对于所测试的两个 gpt-oss 主干模型，规模并不能换来容错性：120B 在故障下保留的无故障分数份额没有更大（p = 0.96），而且在故障下的完成率如果有什么不同的话反而更低（91.1% 对 95.6%；差异 4.4 个百分点，95% CI [-0.2, 9.3]）。
evidence: In a 1,350-cell experiment crossing two backbone sizes (20B, 120B), three agent stacks (custom multi-round plan-and-execute, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangChain), and three fault injection conditions, we find that faults drawn from this permanent-heavy stress profile cause severe quality degradation (task-completion score falls by 60%, from 8.08 to 3.23 out of 10), and that scale does not purchase fault tolerance for the two gpt-oss backbones we test: the 120B retains no larger share of its fault-free score under faults (resilience-ratio model, p = 0.96), and its completion rate under faults is, if anything, lower (91.1% vs.\ 95.6%; difference 4.4 points, 95% CI [-0.2, 9.3]).

highlights.title: HoloBoxing: A Simple Recipe for Humanoid Boxing with 7 Minutes of Single-GPU Training
highlights.authors: Xihan Ma, Bo Zhang, Boxiong Li et al.
highlights.theme: Embodied AI: robot learning and world models
highlights.why: 提出了一种简单的人形拳击训练配方，通过基于预训练的全身控制器，在单个 GPU 上 7 分钟即可完成训练。
highlights.key_result: Table 耗时 422.2 秒，即 7.0 分钟。HoloBoxing（7 分钟版本）在固定六策略联赛中排名第二；长版本排名第一。
evidence: Table accounts for 422.2 seconds, or 7.0 minutes. The new process takes 375.0 seconds; previously recorded prior fitting adds 47.2 seconds.
HoloBoxing (7-min version) ranks second in the fixed six-policy league; the long version ranks first.

highlights.title: Beyond Local Accuracy: Benchmarking the Rollout Reliability of PDE Foundation Models
highlights.authors: Jaewan Park, Seid Koric, Giri Krishnan et al.
highlights.theme: Scientific ML, neural operators, AI-for-science agents
highlights.why: 对 PDE 基础模型的 rollout 可靠性进行基准测试，表明短时域精度在长时域下往往失效，中位误差放大倍数为 2.04。
highlights.key_result: 在 30 个短时域单元中有 26 个、在 24 个全时域单元中有 21 个，至少有一个微调后的基础模型（FM）在所有指标上都优于两个从头训练的基线，表明相对下游优势通常能在更长的评估中保持。然而，绝对保真度的恶化更为普遍：在 144 个配对配置中有 140 个全时域 VRMSE 超过短时域 VRMSE，中位放大倍数为 2.04。
evidence: At least one fine-tuned FM outperforms both scratch baselines in 26 of 30 short-horizon cells and 21 of 24 full-horizon cells under every metric, showing that the relative downstream advantage often survives the longer evaluation. Absolute fidelity, however, deteriorates much more broadly: full-horizon VRMSE exceeds short-horizon VRMSE in 140 of 144 paired configurations, with a median amplification of 2.04.

highlights.title: Compatible Likelihoods for Flow Matching on Manifolds
highlights.authors: Lucas Ng, Georgios Batzolis, Mark Girolami
highlights.why: 展示了黎曼流匹配在平坦环面上的一种失效模式，并提出了一个仅在可行速度上具有支撑的兼容似然目标。
highlights.key_result: 我们提出了一个由端点上的指数族构建的目标函数，以条件速度作为充分统计量，该目标既兼容又仅在可行速度上具有支撑。实证上，我们的方法在测试用例中恢复了正确的速度场，在高维乘积环面上优于先前方法，并在球面上的四个标准地理空间基准中的两个上取得了显著的 NLL 改进，且运行时间开销适中。
evidence: We propose an objective built from an exponential family over endpoints, with the conditional velocity as sufficient statistic, which is both compatible and supported only on feasible velocities.

Empirically, our method recovers the correct velocity field on the test case, outperforms prior methods on high-dimensional product tori, and obtains substantial NLL improvements over prior work on two of four standard geospatial benchmarks on the sphere at moderate runtime overhead.

news.title: Rapidly scaling online storage to serve over 1 billion ChatGPT users (Part II)
news.summary: OpenAI 系列文章的第二部分描述了其如何将 Azure Cosmos DB 扩展为 Habitat 背后的存储层，Habitat 是其在线存储平台，目前为 40 个地理区域的 1 billion 以上用户提供超过 500 petabytes 的数据服务。该文章追溯了从单个共享容器到单租户容器，再回到多租户默认设置的多租户演进历程，最终采用了与 Azure 团队共同开发的共同管理容器方法。

news.title: Securing our frontier model training environment
Bringing foundational models to the front lines of TB screening
news.summary: Google Research 描述了将结核病筛查 AI 从 2019 年 Radiology 基准推进到外部评估、WHO 对 CAD 的推荐、以及 September 2024 在 NEJM AI 上开展的一项前瞻性多中心验证，并走向 MedGemma 等开放基础模型的工作。合作伙伴 Nexus AI 基于胸部 X 光算法构建的临床诊断工具获得了 CE MDR class IIb 认证，相关结果在 Washington, D.C. 的 IDWeek 2026 上展示；该文章称每年估计有 1.23 million 结核病死亡病例。

news.title: Kazakhstan Expands Compute for Its AI Future
news.summary: 在 Astana 于 Oct. 23 举行的一场活动上，NVIDIA 首席执行官 Jensen Huang 会见了总统 Kassym-Jomart Tokayev，并与 AI 部长 Zhaslan Madiyev 交谈，同时 NVIDIA 宣布投资哈萨克斯坦创立的初创公司 Higgsfield AI。Firebird 与政府签署了投资协议，并获得了 45,000 张 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPU 的美国出口许可证，第一阶段正与 Kazakhtelecom 在 Data Center Valley 建设，目标是在 2027 年第三季度投入商业运营。

news.title: Scaling NVIDIA TensorRT Performance Optimization Beyond a Single Build Route with the Global Performance Tuner, Part 2
news.summary: NVIDIA 关于 TensorRT 11.1 Global Performance Tuner 系列文章的第 2 部分描述了将调度选择视为可通过 C++ API 暴露的 200 多个编译器旋钮上的显式、可搜索的构建路径，trtexec 会构建并测量每个候选路径，并根据精度进行过滤。在十个评估工作负载中，调优将端到端性能相比默认构建路径提升了 1.14x 到 1.63x。

news.title: Scaling NVIDIA TensorRT Performance Optimization Beyond a Single Build Route with the Global Performance Tuner, Part 1
news.summary: 第 1 部分将 TensorRT 引擎构建定义为一个基于调度的编译问题，并介绍了在 TensorRT 11.1 中发布的 Global Performance Tuner，它会生成候选构建路径，并选择满足端到端精度约束的最快路径。文章提出了三个指导原则：精度感知调优、可定制构建路径和大解空间。

news.title: Using AI Agents to Teach Robots Like Microduck to Walk in Simulation
news.summary: 该文章介绍了一个训练模拟 Microduck 机器人的工作流程：使用 NVIDIA RTX Spark 上的 Hermes 和 NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 规划障碍赛道，使用 Astra 构建资产，使用 Isaac Sim 配合 Omniverse 和 Newton 进行仿真，并使用 Isaac Lab 在 RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition GPU 上的 4,096 个并行环境中训练运动策略。策略在 RTX Spark 上本地验证后，再使用 Better Actuator Models 和域随机化准备从仿真到真实的迁移。

news.title: LitPivot: Developing research ideas through dynamic contextualization within the literature landscape
news.summary: LitPivot 与宾夕法尼亚大学的合作者共同构建，并使用通过 Asta Paper Finder 检索到的论文，将研究提案划分为问题、贡献和评估等层面，然后按层面对文献进行分组和重新排序，以生成有摘录支持的批评和修改建议。在一项有 17 名研究人员参与的研究中，领域专家评价使用该系统产生的想法比使用文本编辑器和 AI 聊天工具产生的想法更有文献依据；此前对四个项目的分析识别出 21 个文献引发的转向，这项工作将在底特律举行的 UIST 2026 上展示。

news.title: Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning on Amazon SageMaker AI: A hands-on guide

news.title: Orchestrating SageMaker AI endpoint auto scaling with AWS CDK
news.summary: 该文章解释了当 Application Auto Scaling 资源在 CloudFormation 中本机管理时，更新 SageMaker AI 端点配置会失败，并提供了一个可复用的 CDK 构造，用三个自定义资源替换它们，以在更新前后注销和重新注册扩缩容。注册和附加步骤使用异步完成处理程序，每 30 秒轮询一次，提供程序超时时间为 1 小时。

news.title: Visualize points and routes with GeoJSON in Amazon Quick Sight layer maps
news.summary: Amazon Quick Sight 图层地图现在除了多边形之外，还接受 GeoJSON 中的 Point 和 LineString 几何类型，因此用户可以通过共享键将单个位置和路线与数据集连接起来进行绘制。GeoJSON 文件必须为 .geojson 格式，支持的最大大小为 100 MB，并且每个图层一次只渲染一种几何类型。
